content: Mẹ wọ, Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi, oben Mosẹs bi, “Kọ tzima Aarọn, ọmaana Nadab, ọmaana Abihu, ttara adeho arọbh attaan obhiri jobh p'Israẹl, akwu. Bọng awobha k'odenmir akpobh-m.
Yina, kọ Mosẹs mancheni wọ arenga abaanga kaam Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi. Ayok mbonggo kàkhaambi abaanga ka. Anọng mba kakhaambi avura ttar-ẹ.”
Mada Mosẹs ofon ọtza ọgbaak anọng p'Israẹl atzim biphyir p'Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi ọgbaakhi, ọmaana aphaangi pẹ, bẹ abhina k'ogbe wani bi, “Mósi odik kpenamkpen osi kw'Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi okk'obena.”

Mẹ wọ, Mosẹs ọn-ọkkẹr odik kpenamkpen kw'Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi ọkk'ọgbaakha. Ewu ehobh mẹ, obina k'ekpekpebha, ọtza osi ijafọhnibe k'egbegbeho-rin, obiro ọtzọkha mkpọmmachi s'atza jobh obhiri mfa ofhu iduduma, sa mbe nnang ngọma jobh obhiri mfa s'Israẹl.
Mẹ wọ, Mosẹs ọtzọhm adikkobh p'Israẹl bi, bẹ atza anang Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi ẹnanga ẹkwọmichẹ, bẹ abira atzima abhaamva asi ẹjafọhni ch'ẹnanga ch'odidiri anang Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi.
Mosẹs ọtzọkha izi nna rani okhe k'agbanggbang, ọtzọkha s'irikhi opyakhi k'ijafọhnibe.
Mẹ wọ, ọtzọkha Nnwẹr kw'Echekhi oyeri ọnang anọng p'Israẹl. Bẹ abhina bi, “Mọ́si odik kpenamkpen osi kw'Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi okk'obena. Móhakha eho ọhakha ọnang-ẹ.”
Mẹ wọ, Mosẹs ọtzọkha izi nnuma ọpyakhi anọng mba. Oben bi, “Ma wọ ode izi s'echekhi ch'Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi ọkk'ọsa ttara bọng, otzor k'atzim mba biphyir.”
Mẹ wọ, Mosẹs ọmaana Aarọn, ọmaana Nadab, ọmaana Abihu, ttara adeho arọbh attaan obhiri jobh p'Israẹl, afona
atza are Ibinọkpaabyi kw'Israẹl. Ibe s'ọbari mmo ide mach'ibhokhi sa bẹ atzim atza pa saphiya asi, s'ittaani mach'ọrọngkpakpa.
Yina, Ibinọkpaabyi adeho mba p'Israẹl itzama kosi. Bẹ are Ibinọkpaabyi, bẹ achi, abira agwo.
Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi on-oben Mosẹs bi, “Kọ vura akwu k'egbegbeho, awobha ma. Kaam ńnang-ọ atza-gbẹgbẹri pa nkk'aphaangi, ọmaana asana nkkẹra p'ade ndọhna sabẹ.”
Mẹ wọ, Mosẹs ttara Joshua kw'om-otzor-ẹ ọtzọhm, afona. Mosẹs ovura k'egbegbeho ch'Ibinọkpaabyi.
Mosẹs oben adeho mba bi, “Bọng wobha ma, atzik man maa mọkpa nnam. Aarọn ọmaana Hur awobh ma ttara bọng. Ọnọng kpenamkpen kw'ọkhaam ikhakhaanga ttara oyok, ọfha ọtza okhebha bẹ, bẹ attọhna.”
Mada Mosẹs ovur k'egbegbeho nduma, eboni ẹbhọri chẹ.
Abarada p'Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi ahakha m'egbegbeho cha Sinai. Eboni nda ẹbhọri egbegbeho k'iwu izadani. Ottonga iwu izenamfa, Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi oyeri Mosẹs m'eboni ẹtzaanga.
Abarada p'Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi k'egbegbeho ebir-ebir, an-akher anọng p'Israẹl ekpon ch'ẹkwọmi ọttọhk maa fẹ odimi.
Mẹ wọ e, Mosẹs odim k'eboni nda ẹtzaanga, mada ovur k'egbegbeho ebir-ebir. Wa owobha kẹ iwu arọbh afa, ọmaana nnungiwu arọbh afa.
